decisions: The name may not match test_*.py or pytest collects the fixtures as a suite, following the tests/coverage_resolver.py precedent.
Both hot symbols, Holder and KernelFixture, leave with their one outside reader, tests/test_amp_kernel.py, so the 4400-line remainder holds nothing at fan-in three.
